en: Sepia-toned historic photograph showing a Catholic religious procession in front of a Baroque-style church or monastery. Clergy, altar boys and many women and girls in white dresses line up outside the main portal, which has a gabled pediment with a cross on top and decorative relief. To the right stands a small chapel or side structure with a dome-like roof and a canopy set up for the ceremony, with banners and processional lanterns. The architecture has stuccoed walls, rectangular and arched windows with wrought-iron grilles, and a tiled roof, evoking a Central European Baroque church complex.
